ev.q: Among the 130 confirmed cases, 43 (33%) deaths were reported as of October 31.
On October 31, a total of 1,777 contacts were monitored; among these 1,540 (87%) were successfully monitored on that day.
Sixty-one deaths (probable and confirmed cases) were reported
87 (59%) patients are men, and 81 (55%) are residents of Mubende district
Probable (n = 18) and confirmed (n = 130) cases of Ebola virus disease
As of October 31, 45 patients had recovered, 37 patients are undergoing treatment in an ETU, and outcomes are unknown for five.
Among probable and confirmed cases, the median patient age is 29 years (range = 1–70 years), 87 (59%) patients are men
the median age of decedents was 28 years (range = <1–58 years), and 31 (51%) were women
This report describes the fifth outbreak of EVD caused by Sudan ebolavirus in Uganda since 2000

methods_quotes.q: Patients with EVD who were discharged from ETUs with two negative RT-PCR tests 48 hours apart were considered recovered.
